# Macy’s, Inc. to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on December 2, 2026


November 17, 2026


Download (opens in new window)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Macy’s, Inc. (NYSE: M) will report its third quarter 2026 sales and earnings results on Wednesday, December 2. The company will host a call and webcast with analysts and investors at 8:00 a.m. ET. The call will be hosted by Tony Spring, Macy’s, Inc.’s chairman and chief executive officer, and Tom Edwards, chief operating officer and chief financial officer.


The general public and the media will be able to access the live webcast and associated presentation via the company's website at[www.macysinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.macysinc.com&esheet=54640519&newsitemid=20261117643065&lan=en-US&anchor=www.macysinc.com&index=1&md5=f8fcb2495655271ce60b0599a53e73e8) .


To participate in the call, analysts and investors may dial 1-877-407-0832. A replay of the conference call will be available on the company’s website about two hours after the conclusion of the call.


**About Macy’s, Inc.**


Macy’s, Inc. (NYSE: M) is a trusted source for quality brands through our iconic nameplates – Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s and Bluemercury. Headquartered in New York City, our comprehensive digital and nationwide footprint empowers us to deliver a seamless shopping experience for our customers. For more information, visit macysinc.com.


**Media – Isabella Lee**communications@macys.com


**Investors – Caitlin Howe**investors@macys.com
